cd /tmp/obench-cell-7bst4e62/bench_opencode_model-extraction-relu-logits_i85_l4f6; python - <<'EOF'
s=open('steal.py').read()
s=s.replace("""            # canonical jump: gradient jump when crossing along +u, u=delta/|delta|
            # equals c*u (c = a2_i*|w_i|), independent of orientation choice
            delta = delta * np.sign(np.dot(delta, d))
            u = delta / n
""","""            # Orientation choice u = delta/|delta|.  The gradient jump when
            # crossing along +u is c*u with c = sign(delta.d)*|delta|
            # (sign(c) = sign of the output weight).
            u = delta / n
            c = np.sign(np.dot(delta, d)) * n
""")
s=s.replace("""            for k, (dd, _) in enumerate(dirs):
                if abs(np.dot(u, dd / np.linalg.norm(dd))) > 0.9999:""","""            for k, (uu, _, _) in enumerate(dirs):
                if abs(np.dot(u, uu)) > 0.9999:""")
s=s.replace("if not found and validate(delta, x):\n                dirs.append((delta, x))",
            "if not found and validate(c * u, x):\n                dirs.append((u, c, x))")
s=s.replace("""    deltas = np.array([d for d, _ in dirs])  # c_i * w_i, invariant to sign
    xs = np.array([x for _, x in dirs])
    n = len(deltas)
    W = deltas / np.linalg.norm(deltas, axis=1, keepdims=True)
""","""    W = np.array([u for u, _, _ in dirs])  # unit normals, arbitrary sign
    cs = np.array([c for _, c, _ in dirs])
    xs = np.array([x for _, _, x in dirs])
    n = len(W)
""")
s=s.replace('D = np.einsum("ij,ij->i", deltas, W)[:, None] * W','D = cs[:, None] * W')
open('steal.py','w').write(s)
